description: A single speaker in the Even simulator came out as 6 live clusters and '4 speakers from 16 windows' after refinement (rec_2e939b4aa05a474ab5fb, 2026-09-14). clustering.ts PARAMS are uncalibrated defaults (assign 0.55, merge 0.7, minWindowsToConfirm 2, minWindowsToKeep 2). Measure same- vs different-speaker cosine distributions for campplus-voxceleb windows (live window grid) on the multi-speaker fixtures (apps/even-hub/public/fixtures/dev, LibriSpeech speakers A/B/C), pick per-space assign/merge values with margin, and add a regression test that the fixtures resolve to the right speaker count both online and after refinement.
title: Calibrate CAM++ clustering thresholds: one voice split into several speakers
